ideas.pitch: A localized public announcement and civic archiving system that converts official government safety bulletins and public interest notices into hyper-realistic regional Indian languages using ElevenLabs voice cloning, making critical public information accessible to non-literate citizens.
ideas.title: ElevenNarrate Public Interest Voice Archive
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the ElevenLabs sponsor prize track by deeply integrating their voice synthesis API into a real public interest workflow.

ideas.pitch: An interactive ecosystem simulation platform focused on local biodiversity and species monitoring in Central India, featuring real-time analytics and predictive environmental modeling for public awareness.
ideas.title: EcoSim Central India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact architecture of proven environmental dashboard winners with robust simulation loops and clear public utility.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first multilingual medical triage and preliminary symptom collection app built using ElevenLabs speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, designed to assist rural health clinics in rapid patient intake.
ideas.title: VoiceCare AI Health Intake
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines socially impactful healthcare application design with seamless execution of sponsor audio tech.

ideas.pitch: A GPS-enabled civic issue reporting and reward platform that incentivizes citizens to log local infrastructure problems, paired with an AI copilot that automatically routes complaints to the correct municipal department.
ideas.title: CivicPulse Raipur
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on real-world public interest problems mandated by CodeUtsava, delivering a fully working mobile-web demo with immediate municipal utility.

ideas.pitch: An IoT and voice-accessible web platform that warns local farmers and water management authorities about water contamination and irrigation risks days in advance using lightweight ML models and audio briefings.
ideas.title: AgriVoice AquaPredict
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates predictive machine learning for regional public safety while leveraging ElevenLabs audio generation for accessible farmer alerts.
